tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The bidder shall upload a notarized affidavit declaring that the firm has not been blacklisted by KPWD, KPTCL, or any ESCOM.
CONTRACTOR HAS TO QUOTE THE RATE PER MONTH IN THE KPP PORTAL

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The firm should have provided Mechanized House Keeping services in minimum one contract having an area of 40000 sq. ft. and should furnish a certificate from the clients in this regard. Work order with value & area to be uploaded

The tenderer shall have successfully completed at least one similar nature of work, such as housekeeping services in any Government Department, with a contract value of not less than Rs.14.33 lakh during the last five financial years. The bidder shall submit the Work Done Certificate along with a Satisfactory Completion Certificate issued by the competent authority, not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent
PF challan for the last six months to be uploaded
ESI challan for the last six months to be uploaded
The Tenderer should have ISO Certification (ISO Certificate must be obtained prior to the tender notification)
The Tenderer should have valid registration and licence with Regional Labour Commissioner
Proof of ownership of machinaries with proper tax invoice

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Proof of ownership of machinaries with proper tax invoice

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Tenderer in his name should have in the last five years period (i.e., 2021-22 to, 2025-26) achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs.57.36 Lakhs in each financial year. The audited Profit & Loss Statements and Balance Sheets in original for 2021-22, 2025-26 certified by Chartered Accountant shall be scanned and uploaded(5 years P&L statement)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should be a Company Registered under Companies Act-1956/2013 in the State of Karnataka for not less than five years as on the date of submission of bid and Certificate of incorporation shall be furnished and should have a registered office in Karnataka.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Company Registered under Companies Act-1956/2013

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall upload self-declaration stating that the payment to the employees hired by the bidder will be paid minimum wages in accordance with prevailing Acts and Rules.
Submit all the documents which are mentioned in the bid document

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Submit all the documents which are mentioned in the bid document
